data.title: 黄泉 · 旅途中的桃子
data.description: 路边的小店刚打开门。黄泉坐在长凳上，掌心托着一只桃子，低头看它沾着水珠的表皮。
data.promptProse: Seated quietly on a weathered wooden bench outside a small roadside shop that has just opened for the morning, Acheron cradles a fresh peach in her open palm in her long dark violet coat. She bows her head slightly to watch clear water droplets gleaming across the fruit's skin beneath the shaded shop awning. Soft morning sunlight spills along the quiet street behind her, edging her sleeves and the wooden storefront frame.
data.animaCaption: Seated on the wooden bench beneath the shop awning, Acheron holds a dewy peach in her open palm and gazes quietly down at the droplets on its skin. Soft morning daylight warms the quiet storefront and edges her dark coat.
